facts.text: A Model 44 command is the pump address followed by the upper-case command word and optional arguments
A complete response ends in a line-framed one- or two-digit address and one state character
The prompt state characters are ':' stopped, '>' infusing, '<' withdrawing, '/' paused, '*' stalled and '^' trigger wait
The pump address is an integer from 0 to 99
The rate unit tokens the clone sends are UH (uL/h), UM (uL/m), MH (mL/h) and MM (mL/m)
set_rate sends RAT when infusing and RFR when withdrawing, with the numeric rate and the unit token
get_rate queries RAT or RFR and returns the rate and unit parsed from the reply
set_direction sends DIR INF for infuse and DIR REF for withdraw
start sends RUN and verifies the infusing or withdrawing state
stop sends STP through the emergency transport path and confirms the stopped state
query_state sends only the address (the addressed prompt request) and returns the state
request_prompt queries the state with the address alone and never with a bare carriage return
identify sends an addressed prompt request, VER and a second addressed prompt request
get_syringe_info reads the diameter with DIA
set_diameter writes DIA with four decimals and restores the cached rates and direction around it
The canonical directions are infuse and withdraw, with aliases accepted by Direction.coerce
The Model 44 prompt states are normalized as stopped, infusing, refilling, paused, stalled and trigger wait
A bare carriage return is the Model 44 chain-wide STOP ALL command, and the transports reject an empty command
State polling uses the addressed prompt request '<address><CR>'
Normal and emergency application stops use '<address>STP<CR>' independently for each selected pump
A zero flow physically stops the pump
PHD 2000 exposes the diameter through DIA and does not provide syringe manufacturer or model data
The recommended PHD 2000 serial framing is 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and 2 stop bits
SerialTransport uses a carriage return as its terminator
SerialTransport refuses an empty command instead of transmitting a bare carriage return
emergency_transaction cancels queued noncritical updates and sends the stop at queue head
